//: Story Phase 15 crew dialogue: the Stenchmaster Channel, the Top Ten, family of idiots, the economic recovery, creative conversion, the visitors, the chicken incident, the paranoia, the Grand Nap, the nose-fire, the branch at night, the morning and the Great Mellowing, the Untold Stories, the relief shift and the loan, peace, normality, and after.
pete.p15_after_1: pete: Emergency Mellowing Supply, Captain. Grown-ups only. I've put a padlock on the crate. And a sign. And another sign.
pete.p15_after_2: pete: He asks about Agnes every morning. I tell him she's having a nice time. I think she is.
pete.p15_vision_1: pete: (very patiently) Captain. I'm Pete. I've always been Pete. Up the ladder. Air.
pete.p15_normal_1: pete[worried]: (scrambling) Who's on blush? WHO'S ON BLUSH? Captain, it's all come back.
pete.p15_peace_1: pete: (smiling at the ceiling) Isn't it quiet? Isn't it lovely and quiet?
pete.p15_branch2_1: pete: (on his pad, mellow) You're a very good teller, Captain. I can tell. Because of the ding.
pete.p15_untold_1: pete: (on the floor) It's li... it's licen... Captain, what's the word? It's got an L.
pete.p15_mellow_1: pete: (lying on the floor) Brogath's lovely, Captain. Garrick's lovely. You're lovely. Have a cracker.
pete.p15_mellow_2: pete: (watching a lantern swing) ...It goes that way. And then it goes that way.
pete.p15_morning_1: pete: (sitting up) Something's coming down, Hale says. Out of the storm. It's always something.
pete.p15_night_1: pete: (under GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND NAP) Ding. Ding. I can hear it in my sleep. I'm not even asleep.
pete.p15_nosefire_1: pete: (patting out a tiny flame under his nose) ...You said CEREAL BOX, Captain. Out loud. AGAIN.
pete.p15_nap_1: pete[tired]: Grand Nap. Fine. I'll do it grandly. I'll do it however he wants, as long as it's lying down.
pete.p15_paranoia_1: pete[tired]: I'm not Brogath. I'm not a threat. I'm not level five. I'm going to have a lie down.
pete.p15_chicken_1: pete[annoyed]: It's got no INSIDES, Captain. I watched you take them out.
pete.p15_select_1: pete: They're customers, Captain. Real money. Be NICE to them.
pete.p15_select_2: pete: (watching the visitors) Thirty-four, he says. Thirty-FOUR. And he's never seen a shark.
pete.p15_conversion_1: pete: (with the manifest) Forty lots. I've written 'stems' thirty-one times.
pete.p15_recovery_1: pete[worried]: 'A Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Idea.' I heard him say it. I felt it in my TEETH.
pete.p15_family_1: pete: (quietly) Be gentle with him, Captain. He's had a bad day. We've all had a bad day, but his was four hundred years long.
pete.p15_topten_1: pete[worried]: That smell. It's not the stove. I know it's not the stove.
pete.p15_channel_1: pete: (eyes on Brogath's cheeks) Not now, Captain. He's on the edge of pink.
gristle.p15_after_1: gristle: (at the bow, arms folded) Forty feet. Every time they light up. I measure it. Twice.
gristle.p15_vision_1: gristle: (to the captain's wide eyes) I'm Gristle. Same as yesterday. Go and get some AIR.
gristle.p15_normal_1: gristle: (on his feet, scowling at the storm) And THERE'S a bite. They're back. Of course they're back.
gristle.p15_peace_1: gristle: (half asleep) Not a tooth in the hull for a day and a half. I could get used to this.
gristle.p15_untold_1: gristle: (lying on the blanket) You'll want this blanket, Captain. I'm on it. Take it. In a minute.
gristle.p15_mellow_1: gristle: (lying by the rail) Look at 'em, Captain. Sharks. On their backs. Like puppies.
gristle.p15_nosefire_1: gristle: (feeling his eyebrow) ...It's shorter. It's definitely shorter.
gristle.p15_nap_1: gristle: (lying down on OFFICIAL GRAND WAFT SUPPORT STAFF) I've slept on worse. Not much worse.
gristle.p15_paranoia_1: gristle: (very slowly) I'm not ancient, Captain. I'm FORTY-SIX.
gristle.p15_chicken_1: gristle: (flatly) It's on. Of course it's on. Somebody get me a horseshoe.
gristle.p15_select_1: gristle: Open flame. Near HIM. I'll be watching that corner, Captain. Every minute.
gristle.p15_conversion_1: gristle: (sneezing) Dust. Green dust. It's in my BEARD now. Is this how it starts?
gristle.p15_recovery_1: gristle: (at the rail) Forty feet, Captain. I'd make it forty MILES if the ship were bigger.
gristle.p15_family_1: gristle: Lost on their own ship. Two days. I've been on ships like that. I've never been on a CREW like that.
gristle.p15_topten_1: gristle: (sniffing) Lamp's fine. Stove's fine. Then what's ON FIRE?
gristle.p15_channel_1: gristle: (blanket ready, never looking away from the screen) Commercial in ten. Nine...
bob.p15_after_1: bob: I've got a paperweight in every pocket now. Just in case. The visitors think it's a 'look'.
bob.p15_vision_1: bob: (nervously) Captain? Why are you bowing to me?
bob.p15_normal_1: bob: (grabbing the napkin) It moved! Did it move? I'm on it. I'm ON it.
bob.p15_mellow_1: bob: I let go of the napkin, Captain. It didn't go anywhere. It just... lay there. Being a napkin.
bob.p15_paranoia_1: bob: (very still, holding a mug) I'm not going to bend over again. Ever. I'm just going to stand here.
bob.p15_conversion_1: bob: (tying up a bundle) STEMS. Another STEMS. Have we got any LEAF? We've got five leaves.
bob.p15_channel_1: bob: (holding down a napkin that isn't moving) It's about READINESS, Captain.
jim.p15_after_1: jim: Restocking. Again. No beans, Captain. Not a single bean. In honour of Elsie. Against Elsie.
jim.p15_normal_1: jim[alarmed]: (looking at the empty shelves) WHO ATE ALL THE... oh. Oh. It was me. It was all of us.
jim.p15_peace_1: jim: (sitting in the empty stores) There's nothing left, Captain. I ate the 'cereal'. I MADE the cereal.
jim.p15_untold_1: jim: (chewing the curtain tie-back) It's sort of a snack, if you think about it.
jim.p15_mellow_1: jim: (at the stores, eating) Captain. CAPTAIN. Have you ever really tasted a potato? Raw?
jim.p15_nap_1: jim: (lying very still) If Elsie Beanwright ever comes back, Captain, I'm going over the side. I'm telling you now.
jim.p15_conversion_1: jim: (sweeping seeds into a sack) I'm not cooking with any of this. I want that written down.
jim.p15_family_1: jim[alarmed]: Three hundred and forty pages. About breakfast. I can't stop thinking about it.
jim.p15_channel_1: jim: (hand on the sewn-down curtain) If it's got a hem, Captain, it's mine.
ned.p15_after_1: ned: The cloud went under the door, Captain. I'm sorry. I'd shut it. It didn't care.
ned.p15_mellow_1: ned: (lying on the deck) Whoa. (He's picked it up from the visitors.)
ned.p15_recovery_1: ned: (back to the cabin door) Shut, Captain. Shut shut shut.
ned.p15_family_1: ned: (thoughtfully) A Ned before me. Guarded an anchor. That's a good job. Simple. I'd have liked that.
ned.p15_channel_1: ned: It hit me back, Captain. With the AERIAL.
squawks.p15_after_1: squawks: (looking out at the storm) Chicken.
squawks.p15_peace_1: squawks: (sitting next to Agnes) Good chicken.
squawks.p15_select_1: squawks[smug]: (looking at the visitors) Bad hats.
squawks.p15_channel_1: squawks[outraged]: (not moving a feather) No flap.
hale.p15_after_1: hale: The visitors asked me if the wheel was 'a vibe'. I said it was a wheel.
hale.p15_normal_1: hale: (gripping the wheel again) Back to normal, Captain. Holding her. Barely.
hale.p15_mellow_1: hale: (at the wheel, smiling slightly) Holding her, Captain. She's very easy to hold today. Everything is.
hale.p15_select_1: hale: (at the wheel) A boat, Captain. Out of the storm. With a COOL BOX.
nell.p15: nell: The whole ship smelled green for a day and a half. I've never navigated so calmly in my LIFE.
sully.p15: sully: There was a bank in the old quarters, they say. A little one. I heard the bell all night. Ding.
wick.p15: wick: Somebody ate all the hardtack. ALL of it. Even the bad barrel. Even the barrel.
rook.p15: rook: The captain's put a padlock on a crate on deck. EMERGENCY MELLOWING SUPPLY. Grown-ups only. I'm a grown-up. He says not THAT grown-up.
brask.p15: brask: Two men in a little white boat, Captain. They call everything 'man'. They called ME 'man'. I liked it.
jory.p15: jory: Is it true a chicken came down out of the storm on a PARACHUTE?
mags.p15: mags: I knitted the chicken a little hat. She's in the storm now. I hope she's wearing it.
quill.p15: quill: Twenty-four rules now. The captain's added three. One of them is about his beard.
garrick.p15_after_1: garrick[businesslike]: The Committee for the Restocking of the Stores is now in session, Captain. You're not on it.
garrick.p15_after_2: garrick[smug]: A Beard Reserve, Captain. Hear me out.
garrick.p15_after_3: garrick: I miss it too, Captain. The green one. I had no idea what a spoon was, before.
garrick.p15_vision_1: garrick: (wearing too many sashes, with a light behind him) Captain? Are you quite well? Why are you kneeling?
garrick.p15_normal_1: garrick[businesslike]: GRAND DECREE, Captain. The stores are empty. I'm forming a COMMITTEE. And a sub-committee. To look into the committee.
garrick.p15_peace_1: garrick: (gnawing on a spoon) Lovely jerky, this.
garrick.p15_branch2_1: garrick: (on the Grand Pad) A sash-backed loan, Captain. I read about those. They sound... nice.
garrick.p15_untold_1: garrick: (staring at the screen) It's so smooth. Like a window. Into a sash.
garrick.p15_mellow_1: garrick: (holding a spoon to the light) Captain. A spoon. Look at it. LOOK at it.
garrick.p15_mellow_2: garrick: (waving a hand) Decrees? Nah. Decrees are... (a long pause) ...a lot.
garrick.p15_night_1: garrick: (on the Grand Pad) HHHNNNRRRK. ...late fees... HHHNNNRRRK.
garrick.p15_nap_1: garrick[proud]: Rule four of the Grand Nap, Captain: nobody snores louder than the Grand Stenchmaster. I'll be enforcing it.
garrick.p15_paranoia_1: garrick: Captain, why have you graded me 'evacuate reality'? I'm eating a biscuit.
garrick.p15_chicken_1: garrick[delighted]: The Wrath of Brogath! And it knew about Tuesday! Captain, that set has SOURCES.
garrick.p15_select_1: garrick[proud]: STINKBEARD'S SELECT SCENT OF SKUNK. I've done a little drawing for the crates. It's you. Winking.
garrick.p15_conversion_2: garrick[businesslike]: Wholesale, Captain. The King wants WHOLESALE. We're in BUSINESS.
garrick.p15_recovery_1: garrick[businesslike]: (stretching his neck) A controlled productivity exercise, Captain. I've been training for this all my life. Insulting people.
garrick.p15_family_1: garrick[offended]: It was a very good Elsie, Captain. She had an AURA.
garrick.p15_topten_1: garrick[laugh]: (still wheezing) The GOAT, Captain. It just... went OVER.
garrick.p15_channel_1: garrick[delighted]: Captain! History! Economics! ADVERTS! This is everything I've ever wanted from a box.
brogath.p15_after_1: brogath[thoughtful]: Ancient Historical Consultant, reporting. Remaining confident. Mostly.
brogath: (looking at the porthole) She'll come round again, won't she, Captain? On her pillow?
brogath.p15_after_2: brogath[proud]: I've read the captain's rules. All of them. 'Not selectable.' Quite right. I've never chosen one in my life.
brogath.p15_after_3: brogath[bashful]: You called me part of the crew, Captain. Twice. I've counted.
brogath.p15_vision_1: brogath[confused]: (waving) Captain? Over here. I'm the cardboard one. The REAL one.
brogath.p15_normal_1: brogath[alarmed]: Captain, my SASH, it's... and where's AGNES? Where's Agnes?
brogath.p15_peace_1: brogath: (watching the thread) Up. And down. Lovely.
brogath.p15_branch2_1: brogath: (Agnes on his foot) Is that my bank? It's very small. Is it still open? I don't feel very bashful.
brogath.p15_untold_1: brogath: Untold stories, Captain! Ooh, I'd forgotten the well.
brogath.p15_mellow_1: brogath: (Agnes on his foot) Agnes the Second, Captain. Isn't she lovely? Isn't everything lovely?
brogath.p15_mellow_2: brogath: (watching a loose thread on his sash go up and down) It's fluttering. I don't mind at all. Isn't that odd?
brogath.p15_morning_1: brogath[bashful]: Something's coming down, they say? I hope it isn't a goat.
brogath.p15_night_1: brogath[bashful]: (not looking at the back of the room) I'm sorry about the bank, Captain. It just... happens. When I'm like this.
brogath.p15_nap_1: brogath[bashful]: I don't really need to nap, Captain. I'll just stand here. Grandly.
brogath.p15_paranoia_1: brogath[confused]: I keep telling them I'm the cardboard one. Nobody believes me. It's the first time I've ever WANTED to be believed about that.
brogath.p15_chicken_1: brogath[thoughtful]: Agnes. She was a very good chicken. She sat on my foot.
brogath.p15_select_1: brogath[delighted]: They WAVED at me, Captain. The visitors. Nobody waves at cardboard.
brogath.p15_conversion_1: brogath[proud]: (dusting himself off) I'm an ECONOMIST, Captain. A creative one.
brogath.p15_conversion_2: brogath[confused]: Doesn't accept FARTS? Then what IS his money?
brogath.p15_recovery_1: brogath[proud]: A Grand Idea, Captain. A GRAND one. You'll see.
brogath.p15_family_1: brogath[thoughtful]: (looking at the dark set) Billiam would have made a column for today. 'Losses: one television. Gains: none.'
brogath.p15_topten_1: brogath[embarrassed]: (in his own green haze) That wasn't my usual. I don't know what that was. I think it was the goat.
brogath.p15_channel_1: brogath[delighted]: (in the front row) It's ME, Captain! I'm on again! I'm ECONOMIC!
visitor_one.p15_after_1: visitor_one: (in his folding chair, at the bow) We'll go home eventually, Captain. Probably. Is that okay? The sharks have got our boat's engine.
visitor_one.p15_after_2: visitor_one: (gazing at the storm) There's a chicken out there on a pillow. Going round. And she's FINE. That's the most hopeful thing I've ever seen.
visitor_one.p15_normal_1: visitor_one: (sitting up) Whoa. The air's... regular. That's so much worse.
visitor_one.p15_peace_1: visitor_one: (in his chair at the bow) This is it, man. This is the clambake. We did it. HE did it.
visitor_one.p15_branch2_1: visitor_one: You're good at this, Captain. Real banking energy. Hostile, but real.
visitor_one.p15_untold_1: visitor_one: (lying on the galley floor) He fired himself out of a cannon. I respect that so much.
visitor_one.p15_mellow_1: visitor_one: (staring up into the green) The sky is the colour of a pear, Captain. The whole SKY.
visitor_one.p15_night_1: visitor_one: (lying awake) That duke said 'all of it' and he MEANT all of it.
visitor_one.p15_nosefire_1: visitor_one: (touching his nose) My nose did a little dragon. That's never happened.
visitor_one.p15_nap_1: visitor_one: Themed, man. Not scented. That's the whole difference.
visitor_one.p15_paranoia_1: visitor_one: (crouched, deadly serious) Level four, Captain. That hull. It's holding something BACK.
visitor_one.p15_chicken_1: visitor_one: (to the Mark II) Haunted TV. With history. Respect.
visitor_one.p15_select_1: visitor_one: (in his folding chair) This is the best hallucination I've ever had, Captain. Ten out of ten. The sharks especially.
visitor_two.p15_after_1: visitor_two: We've got forty lots of you-know-what and a safe corner and a pirate captain. We're good, man. We're GOOD.
visitor_two.p15_after_2: visitor_two: (reading the captain's rules on the barricade, nodding) Grown-ups only. Respect. Total respect.
visitor_two.p15_normal_1: visitor_two: (grabbing his friend) Bro. The sharks are the right way up again. I don't like it.
visitor_two.p15_peace_1: visitor_two: Best birthday ever. And it's been, like, four days.
visitor_two.p15_branch2_1: visitor_two: Gary! Bro, GARY. I'd have lunch with Gary. Maybe not lunch.
visitor_two.p15_untold_1: visitor_two: A chicken coop bank! Bro, the HENS spent it. That's the best thing I've ever heard.
visitor_two.p15_mellow_1: visitor_two: (on his back on the deck) The sharks are SMILING, Captain. Look at 'em. One of them waved.
visitor_two.p15_night_1: visitor_two: (sitting up) The countess said 'compounded', bro. During. DURING.
visitor_two.p15_nap_1: visitor_two: (wrapped in OFFICIAL GRAND WAFT SUPPORT STAFF) I'm buying these online when I get home. If I get home.
visitor_two.p15_paranoia_1: visitor_two: (saluting) Anti-Stenchmaster Guard reporting, Captain! That parrot is ROYALTY!
visitor_two.p15_chicken_1: visitor_two: Agnes, man. AGNES. I'd die for Agnes. I've known her four minutes.
visitor_two.p15_select_1: visitor_two: Bro, a PIRATE told me about fire safety. My mum is never going to believe this.
visitor_one.idle: visitor_one: (nodding slowly at nothing in particular) Whoa.

then: Agnes the Second looks up at you with mild interest, and goes back to the floor, which is more interesting.

branch_teller.idle: branch_teller: (polishing the bell) Good evening, Captain. Open so long as he remains bashful. (lowering his voice) Always.

then: branch_teller: Forty years, sir. Never a tea break. One day, perhaps.
